# AcaiFlow

> AcaiFlow is a healthy bowl café in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. Motto: "eat well, feel good." We serve signature wholefood bowls (Healthier Choice certified by the Malaysian Ministry of Health), build-your-own bowls, sourdough focaccia sandwiches, açaí bowls, and longevity smoothies.

## Menu (https://acaiflow.my/menu)

- Signature Wholefood Bowls (all HCL-certified, macros published): Zen Sleep (312 kcal), Beauty Bowl (498 kcal), Plant Protein (438 kcal), Energy Bowl (489 kcal), Anti-Inflammatory (393 kcal), High Protein (500 kcal)
- Build Your Own Bowl: Small (2 bases, ½ protein, 2 supplements, 1 topping, 1 dressing), Medium (2/1/3/1/1), Large (2/2/3/1/1) — interactive macro calculator at https://acaiflow.my/calculator
- Sourdough Focaccia Sandwiches: Carprese Chicken, Roasted Fuel Chicken, Classic Beef, Omega Boost Tuna
- Açaí Bowls (9 varieties, peanut/almond butter drizzle; best sellers Island Escape and Coco Glow)
- Longevity Smoothies (6) with add-on boosters: cocoa + monk fruit whey, creatine, collagen, protein powder
- Prices available in-store or via WhatsApp

## Locations (https://acaiflow.my/location)

- Green Heights Mall: Lot LG09, Ground Floor, 129 Lorong Lapangan Terbang 2, 93250 Kuching, Sarawak — daily 10:00 AM–7:00 PM, phone +60 13-816 0023
- Kuching International Airport: L2A19, Level 2, Domestic Departure (airside) — hours follow flight schedule
